import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Disable progress bars
os.environ["RAPIDS_NO_INITIALIZE"] = "1"

print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Columns: {list(train_df.columns)}")

# Separate features and target
train_id = train_df["Id"]
train_features = train_df.drop(["Id", "Cover_Type"], axis=1)
train_target = train_df["Cover_Type"]

test_id = test_df["Id"]
test_features = test_df.drop(["Id"], axis=1)

# Fill any NaN values using median from training features
train_features = train_features.fillna(train_features.median())
test_features = test_features.fillna(train_features.median())

print(f"Target classes: {train_target.nunique()}")
print(f"Train feature shape: {train_features.shape}")
print(f"Test feature shape: {test_features.shape}")

# Create validation split without stratification (fixing the class imbalance issue)
val_split = 0.1
train_val_features, val_features, train_val_target, val_target = train_test_split(
    train_features,
    train_target,
    test_size=val_split,
    random_state=42,
    # Removed stratify to avoid error with rare classes
)

print(f"Validation size: {len(val_target)}")

# Train Random Forest classifier
print("Training Random Forest...")
rf = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    max_depth=15,
    min_samples_split=5,
    min_samples_leaf=2,
    n_jobs=-1,
    random_state=42,
)

rf.fit(train_val_features, train_val_target)
print("Training complete!")

# Evaluate on validation set
val_predictions = rf.predict(val_features)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(val_target, val_predictions)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Make predictions on test set
print("Predicting test set...")
test_predictions = rf.predict(test_features)

# Create submission file
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_id, "Cover_Type": test_predictions})

# Save to required location
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv with {len(submission_df)} rows")

# Verify submission file exists and format is correct
assert os.path.exists("./submission/submission.csv"), "Submission file not found!"
submission_check = pd.read_csv("./submission/submission.csv")
assert list(submission_check.columns) == [
    "Id",
    "Cover_Type",
], "Submission columns mismatch!"
print(f"Submission format verified: {list(submission_check.columns)}")

print("Done!")
